name: ANGEL ROBOTICS Co., Ltd.
summary: ANGEL ROBOTICS Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing and selling of intelligent wearable robots. It offers ANGEL LEGS M20 for incomplete paralysis patients; MW10 for muscular reconstruction, and joints athletic recovery; ANGEL SUIT H10, a walking preparation robot; gear's; and kits. ANGEL ROBOTICS Co., Ltd. was formerly known as SG Robotics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ANGEL ROBOTICS Co., Ltd. in September 2018. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
